headline: Sensex and Nifty decline for second day as rising oil prices and IT sector losses weigh on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Rising bond yields impacting market sentiment
Significant selling pressure in the IT sector
whatHappening: Sensex fell for the second consecutive day, ending 217 points down
Nifty 50 closed at 22,716, slipping below the 22,750 mark
Tata Chemicals shares declined by 4.5% amid high oil prices
NCLAT issued notices regarding Subhash Chandra's insolvency plea
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed lower for the second consecutive session, pressured by rising oil prices and bond yields. Tata Chemicals was a notable loser, dropping 4.5%, while the IT index emerged as the top sectoral laggard. Market volatility was further influenced by monthly F&O expiry and global cues.
